name: Get your transactional email activity aggregated over a period of time
description: Get your transactional email activity aggregated over a period of time. This endpoint will show the aggregated stats for past 90 days by default if `startDate` and `endDate` OR `days` is not passed. The date range can not exceed 90 days

startDate.description: **Mandatory if endDate is used.** Starting date of the report (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be lower than equal to endDate

endDate.description: **Mandatory if startDate is used.** Ending date of the report (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be greater than equal to startDate

days.description: Number of days in the past including today (positive integer, maximum 90). _Not compatible with 'startDate' and 'endDate'_. Defaults to 90 if neither dates nor days are provided.

blocked.description: Number of blocked contact emails for the timeframe

clicks.description: Number of clicks for the timeframe

delivered.description: Number of delivered emails for the timeframe

hardBounces.description: Number of hardbounces for the timeframe

invalid.description: Number of invalid emails for the timeframe

opens.description: Number of openings for the timeframe

requests.description: Number of requests for the timeframe

softBounces.description: Number of softbounces for the timeframe

spamReports.description: Number of complaint (spam report) for the timeframe

uniqueClicks.description: Number of unique clicks for the timeframe

uniqueOpens.description: Number of unique openings for the timeframe

unsubscribed.description: Number of unsubscribed emails for the timeframe

execution.auth: API key in the api-key header, or OAuth 2.0. Not included here.
